name: Marketplace
description: Multi-vendor directory: vendors apply publicly, the admin approves them, and each vendor manages their own product listings through a code-protected self-service portal. Buyers browse approved vendors' products in a Puck block and contact vendors via per-product inquiries (v1 = lead generation, no centralized checkout).
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: List vendors, products and buyer inquiries (own prefixed tables only).
Create/update vendors, products, inquiries and the plugin's own settings table (own prefixed tables only).
Register the marketplace API endpoints under /api/v1/plugin/vendor-marketplace/* (public catalog, vendor portal, admin management).
Add the Marketplace entry to the admin sidebar.
Notify vendors when their store is approved (access code) and forward buyer inquiries to the vendor's email.
